name: Cheers for your ship: Boop is proud, with a sign
case: Three buddies in the world cheered the ship you just pushed, all in one moment. Boop is proud of it: a face, not small, in silence, and a sign that thanks them or says you shipped.
why: MomentRule.world: cheers for your ship make it proud, medium, with a sign and no word: a boop from the world is no skit. The rule makes the moment, so no Jev is asked.
